scope: MEDIA/SCIENTIFIC AGE ONLY after user correction. Ancient narrative leads excluded from main results.

candidates.researcher: Elisheva Rosman, Department of Political Studies, Bar-Ilan University
candidates.claimed_witnesses: Avner Azulai describes group; total unspecified. Rosman identifies four recorded testimonies, three filmed and one radio; not four independent events.
candidates.matches: Media age; named first-person witness; group claim; womanlike luminous figure; divine protection explicitly Jewish.
candidates.mismatches: No public sustained gathering; no event film located; no independently verified co-witness roster; January rumors preceded May named testimony; filmed versions describe elderly Arab woman rather than light.
candidates.assessment: Closest qualitative modern female/luminous Jewish apparition found, substantially weaker public-documentary comparability to claimed Zeitoun core.

candidates.candidate: Posthumous Rebbe sightings, including Ramat Aviv
candidates.event_date: After June1994; Ramat Aviv thread comments mostly2007, later2015 post
candidates.researchers: Simon Dein, UCL Mental Health Science (affiliation in2010 paper); Yoram Bilu, Hebrew University anthropology/psychology
candidates.claimed_witnesses: Generally individuals by promoter own account; occasional family/co-witness claims, including at least three purported seers in one2007 comment. No mass optical sighting established.
candidates.matches: Modern repeated sightings; some named direct testimony; photography claim; believer/nonobservant Jewish range claimed.
candidates.mismatches: Usually private; camera claim is image-only with unknown figure back to camera; no comparable cross-religious mass sighting; ritual crowd presence not optical co-witness count.
candidates.assessment: Strongest sustained Jewish apparition tradition found; not equivalent to Zeitoun.

candidates.type: public physical phenomenon with messianic interpretation
candidates.claimed_witnesses: Publicly accessible damp patch drawing worshippers; no verified total
candidates.matches: Contemporary press; publicly inspectable object; Jewish location; religious interpretation.
candidates.mismatches: 40x10cm damp patch rather than luminous person; IAA archaeologist Jon Seligman suggested faulty pipe; initial story left cause unresolved; supernatural status not established.
candidates.assessment: Physical public observation genuine subject of contemporary coverage, poor analogue.

candidates.claimed_witnesses: Parade audience; surviving archival film and posted transcript. Exact crowd count not audited.
candidates.matches: Advance publicly delivered assurance; religious linkage to observance; observable subsequent successful outcome.
candidates.mismatches: General success assurance, no exact sign/date/image; victory has military mechanisms; archive attribution inspected but original film not independently authenticated in this pass.
candidates.assessment: Best original archival prediction lead located, rather than a demonstrated supernatural event.

candidates.event_date: 1986 according to photo context; interview September2011
candidates.identified_people: Patient general surgeon Leonard Lovitch, wife Sharon; treating surgeon Steven E. Feldon
candidates.matches: Identified first-person patient, interviewed with wife; specific injury, surgery and named treating specialist; claimed connection to ritual advice from Rebbe.
candidates.mismatches: Retrospective oral history; no medical records or independent Feldon endorsement recovered; healed over weeks, not eyewitness mass instantaneous repair.
candidates.assessment: Best specific modern Jewish healing lead found for further record-level audit, not clinical verification.

candidates.identified_people: Patient Yisroel Swimmer; uncle Dr Rodney Unterslak
candidates.matches: Named first-person testimony; exact visit date; alleged multiple diagnoses and subsequent absence of retinitis pigmentosa; religiously directed outcome.
candidates.mismatches: No records reproduced; specialists unnamed; not established total blindness before cure; retrospective testimony.
candidates.assessment: Serious identifiable lead with large diagnosis-validation gap.

candidates.candidate: Baba Sali soldier recovery / inexhaustible arak
candidates.event_date: Reported soldier after1973 war; later anecdotes
candidates.matches: Modern miracle-worker tradition with bodily cure and multiplication claims.
candidates.mismatches: Source explicitly presents anecdotes; no named soldier/primary records retrieved; cannot substitute popularity for clinical documentation.
candidates.assessment: Famous great-miracle tradition worth future tracing, lower documentation than named Lovitch/Swimmer cases.

candidates.type: large public religious gathering with miracle tradition
candidates.matches: Very large modern public religious attendance; miracles sought; spiritual light language.
candidates.mismatches: Source describes human-lit bonfires symbolizing spiritual light, not hundreds of thousands seeing an unlit supernatural figure.
candidates.assessment: Do not count mass attendance as a mass miracle.
